# sonarqube_qualitygate_usergroup_association (Resource)

Allows a user or group to edit a quality gate. Import ID: `gate[user/login]` or `gate[group/name]`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lets a group edit one quality gate without global gate administration.
resource "sonarqube_qualitygate_usergroup_association" "platform" {
  gatename   = "Strict"
  group_name = "platform-team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gatename` (String) Name of the quality gate.

### Optional

- `group_name` (String) Group to grant. Conflicts with login_name.
- `login_name` (String) User to grant. Conflicts with group_name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_qualitygate_usergroup_association.example 'Strict[group/platform-team]'
```
